watchme.trigger: each read of the probe over the loop's own pulse-roster record (~/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/0/) — no clock, no new firing path; it rides the shim's existing pulse like every probe in the corpus. TRUE when the record shows pulse activations and deactivations whose (served_at - file_mtime) is at most 2 beats, under an unchanged pid.
watchme.enough: 10 add-or-remove events measured within-a-beat with zero loop restarts across them — enough to separate 'discovery serves' from 'the one demo worked'; after that the property is load-bearing and ordinary reds cover regressions.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier
watchme.nexus: the hypothesize tree — the expectation 'presence is service, within one beat, no restart' is the hypothesis each measured event confirms or kills
watchme.consumer: Akien at the gate, and the next voyage that touches the loop (the probe's record is the evidence that discovery held while the corpus changed under it)
